scientific_integrity: Direct formal-series proof and an independent finite coefficient computation are supplied. Prior colored-partition definitions and the classical quadratic-form count are explicitly credited. No priority, authorship, publication, or independent validation is asserted.

title: An exact modulo-eight divisor law for four-colored odd-part partitions
